LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubarmor.label: Hellion subarmor
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipSubarmor.description: A reinforced structural layer with flooring on top that forms the deck of a Hellion. Built from dense grav-hardened alloys, this subarmor is completely indestructible, shielding the aircraft from artillery impact and crash-landing damage. Only things on top of this substructure can be lifted by the Hellion engine's levitation field. This floor must be constructed within range of a Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySubstructure.description: A lightweight truss structure with flooring on top that forms the deck of an enemy Hellion. Cannot be claimed or used by anyone but the enemy crew. Can be deconstructed to yield some resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyDamagedSubstructure.description: A damaged lightweight truss structure with flooring on top that forms the deck of an enemy Hellion. Cannot be claimed or used by anyone but the enemy crew. Can be deconstructed to yield some resources.
